secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign mock-auth session cookies. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32. Required when AUTH_MODE=mock (the default).

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://your-project.supabase.co). Required only when AUTH_MODE=supabase.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon public key. Required only when AUTH_MODE=supabase.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role key. Used only by scripts (create-user, reset-password), never in client bundles.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
secrets.description: Google service account email for Sheets API. Required only when SHEETS_MODE=real.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: Google service account private key (with \n escapes). Required only when SHEETS_MODE=real.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_SHEET_ID
secrets.description: Google Spreadsheet ID. Required only when SHEETS_MODE=real.
